summary_en: This study tests risvutatug rezetecan (also called Ris-Rez or GSK5764227) in adults with advanced gastrointestinal cancers that cannot be surgically removed and that were previously treated, with colorectal and pancreatic cancer cohorts listed. How it is given is not stated, and the dose and schedule are not stated. The record does not name a main outcome measure; it says the study will check how well the medicine works, how safe it is, and how the body handles it, and the study is Phase 1b/2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa risvutatug rezetecan (también llamado Ris-Rez o GSK5764227) en adultos con cánceres gastrointestinales avanzados que no se pueden extirpar con cirugía y que ya recibieron tratamiento, e incluye cohortes de cáncer colorrectal y de páncreas. No se indica cómo se administra, ni la dosis ni la frecuencia. El registro no nombra un resultado principal; indica que el estudio verificará qué tan bien funciona el medicamento, qué tan seguro es y cómo lo maneja el cuerpo, y el estudio es de Fase 1b/2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older, or the legal age of consent where the study takes place.
Unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic colon or rectal adenocarcinoma (colorectal cohort).
Unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (pancreatic cohort).
Willing to use adequate contraception and able to give informed consent.
not_for: Prior treatment with an antibody-drug conjugate that has a TOPO1-inhibitor payload.
Untreated brain or CNS metastases, or brain/CNS metastases that have progressed.
Current or past interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis, or suspected pneumonitis that imaging cannot rule out.
Prior allogeneic or autologous bone marrow transplant or other solid organ transplant.
